meta.purpose: Policy-owned merge package risk adjustments and generated UI smoke safety controls.

dynamic_import.reason: Dynamic import calls can hide runtime dependency edges from static merge packaging.

dynamic_route.reason: Dynamic smoke routes require seeded params or fixtures to avoid false-negative browser gates.
